item.title: Up to $450 per pet: Tax credit would benefit dog or cat owners in NY
item.description: This proposal would allow pet owners to claim credits for expenses incurred in 2026 for up to two animals.

item.title: Chain-link surprise: Feds erect fence partially blocking Statue of Liberty views
item.description: A new security gate is frustrating tourists and residents blocking scenic views of the Statue of Liberty off of Manhattan’s southern tip.

item.title: Baseball returns to The Bronx: New York Yankees host Miami Marlins to kickoff first homestand
item.description: Pregame ceremonies begin at 1 p.m., with team introductions and ceremonial first pitches from USA Olympic gold medalists Jack Hughes and Aerin Frankel.

item.title: Aaron Judge leads Yankees to 8-2 victory over the Marlins in home opener
item.description: Aaron Judge hit a first inning home run to open the scoring for the Yankees, who ended up winning 8-2 over the Miami Marlins in their first home game.

item.title: 2nd suspect in custody in Brooklyn drive-by shooting that killed baby girl in stroller
item.description: The second suspect wanted in connection with the deadly shooting of a 7-month-old girl in Brooklyn was taken into custody two states away, police said.

item.title: United Airlines joins JetBlue in raising checked bag fees. How much more will it cost?
item.description: For the second time in less than a week, a major U.S. airline is raising its fees for checked bags amid the war in the Middle East that has disrupted oil supplies and led to a spike in fuel prices. United Airlines announced that starting Friday, most passengers will pay $10 more to check luggage.

item.title: Red eye relief? Or not. Massive eye drops recall expands to 3.1 million bottles
item.description: Walgreens, CVS, Rite Aid and other retailers sold the recalled eye drops. Here's what you should know.

item.title: 'She was good': Heartbroken grandma speaks on Brooklyn baby death; manhunt ongoing for suspect
item.description: The grandmother of a baby girl whose shooting death has reignited cries for more stringent measures to combat gun violence in New York City says her family is hurting, but leaning on faith to manage this tragedy. “God is the ultimate judge in the world,” Linda Oyinkoinyan said. item.title: 'Hello, world': Artemis II crew captures new look at Earth on trip to the moon
item.description: The Artemis II astronauts have captured Earth's brilliant beauty as they zoom ever closer to the moon.

item.title: U.S. fighter jet downed over Iran, one pilot rescued, official says
item.description: One F-15 crew member was rescued and a search was underway for a second after a fighter jet went down over Iran.
